topology_reasoning.device_identification: A symmetric four-port multimode waveguide crossing (a compact 2x2 crossing), viewed as four identical adiabatic horn transitions joined in a small central overlap.
topology_reasoning.operation: Light entering any cardinal port expands through a short, smooth multimode region at the crossing and is recaptured by the opposing transition. The orthogonal pair is the second through path; fourfold symmetry suppresses directional bias.
image_observations: The material is one connected, fourfold-symmetric cross with horizontal and vertical narrow rectangular access guides.
Each guide broadens smoothly into an almond/teardrop-shaped multimode lobe; the four lobes overlap at the center with no visible hole.
The calibrated material bbox is square (4.7 um by 4.7 um), so a centered symmetric construction is appropriate.

function_defining_knobs.access_lead_length_um: common access-lead length at the symmetric recreation point
function_defining_knobs.delta_length: east-port access-length detuning from the symmetric point, a real geometry knob verified by the parametric response check
function_defining_knobs.taper_length_um: axial length of each expansion/recompression transition
function_defining_knobs.peak_width_um: maximum multimode width of each horn
function_defining_knobs.profile_exponent: controls how quickly the horn reaches and leaves its maximum width
function_defining_knobs.central_overlap_um: amount of mutual central overlap, controlling the crossing junction

topology_reasoning.implementation_plan: Use primitive tapers and rectangles assembled under @gf.cell. Each lobe is approximated with a sequence of short linear taper primitives, with mirrored copies in the four cardinal directions; no prebuilt device cell or raw polygon emission is used.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only fourfold crossing: 16-segment smooth taper horns (0.23 um access, 0.91 um maximum, 1.80 um taper) plus 0.55 um access leads. The calibrated rendered bbox exactly matches 4.7 um by 4.7 um. Stopped because IoU exceeded the 0.85 Phase-A threshold.
